title: Inspection Intervals, Grace and Odometer Reporting by Keyturn Vehicle Listing Class
content:
The inspection clock of a Keyturn Vehicle Listing runs on miles and on days at once, and each class sets both intervals, both graces, the channels an inspection may be carried out through, the fees, and how often the host must report the odometer.

| Class | Inspection required before listing | Mileage interval (miles) | Day interval (calendar days) | Mileage grace (miles) | Day grace (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | not required | 7500 | 365 | 500 | 14 |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | not required | 7500 | 365 | 500 | 14 |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | required | 6000 | 270 | 400 | 10 |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | required | 5000 | 180 | 250 | 7 |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | required | 2500 | 120 | 100 | 3 |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | required | 10000 | 180 | 750 | 10 |

| Class | Ways an inspection may be carried out | Inspection fee (USD) | Re-inspection fee (USD) | Host reporting interval (calendar days) | Variance tolerance on a host reading (miles) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | host photographs, partner workshop | 39.00 | 25.00 | 90 | 50 |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | host photographs, partner workshop, telematics report | 49.00 | 30.00 | 90 | 50 |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | partner workshop, marketplace inspector, telematics report | 79.00 | 45.00 | 60 | 35 |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | partner workshop, marketplace inspector | 125.00 | 75.00 | 45 | 25 |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | marketplace inspector | 275.00 | 165.00 | 30 | 10 |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | partner workshop, marketplace inspector | 95.00 | 55.00 | 30 | 75 |

A class that does not list a channel does not accept an inspection carried out that way: a Keyturn Exotic Class Listing is inspected by a marketplace inspector and by nothing else, while a Keyturn Standard Class Listing accepts host photographs, a partner workshop or a telematics report.
